environmentSources.MAIL_PROVIDER: Hosted SendGrid or Resend in rer-setup.json; the generated local manifest selects the development outbox. See OPERATIONS.md
environmentSources.MAIL_FROM: Production sender for the Worker, supplied in the shell or an --env-file on the first deploy; setup keeps a local sender. See OPERATIONS.md
environmentSources.SENDGRID_API_KEY: Production credential for the selected mail provider; configure hosted mail before deploy, including dry-run. Local setup needs no provider credentials. See OPERATIONS.md
environmentSources.RESEND_API_KEY: Production credential for the selected mail provider; configure hosted mail before deploy, including dry-run. Local setup needs no provider credentials. See OPERATIONS.md
environmentSources.CLOUDFLARE_EMAIL_API_TOKEN: Production credential for the selected mail provider; configure hosted mail before deploy, including dry-run. Local setup needs no provider credentials. See OPERATIONS.md
environmentSources.CLOUDFLARE_EMAIL_ACCOUNT_ID: Production credential for the selected mail provider; configure hosted mail before deploy, including dry-run. Local setup needs no provider credentials. See OPERATIONS.md
environmentSources.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID: Owner's Cloudflare account id, supplied in the shell only for owner-account deploy. See OPERATIONS.md
environmentSources.CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN: Owner's scoped Cloudflare API token, supplied in the shell only for owner-account deploy. See OPERATIONS.md

setup.effects: Generate private settings, build, apply additive local migrations, bootstrap one explicit owner and request an ordinary outbox sign-in; stop temporary descendants.

dev.effects: Serve Vite HMR on explicit loopback through the shared managed lifecycle; health and outbox gate readiness.

preview.effects: Serve fixed production output on explicit loopback through the shared managed lifecycle.

build.effects: Build production assets with private settings removed during bundling.

verify.effects: Run product checks, the complete recursive onboarding suite, build, types, runtime and browser journeys and the README journey.

reset.effects: Require confirmation and inactive installation; remove only shared local state/settings/installer inventory.

deploy.effects: Build and package the Worker and every migration, then deploy to the owner's Cloudflare account through Base deploy-kit owner mode and check health. Dry run makes no provider request.

export.effects: Export complete private product data through Base portability with credentials excluded; requires a new private archive path.

import.effects: Confirm and restore a verified Base archive into empty, inactive local state, then recover explicitly mapped identities offline.

outbox.effects: Open the configured-loopback development outbox; no external message delivery.

doctor.effects: Inspect declared local inputs, settings presence and pinned tooling without exposing secrets.

check.effects: Check the first-party command contract, aliases, pins and operations descriptor without credentials.

release.effects: Run Base release checks, including the publication scan; never pushes, tags or deploys.

artifact.effects: Produce the schema-2 Worker artifact for the pinned trusted-build workflow from committed source; no deployment.

artifact-local.effects: Build the exact clean committed source and write local schema-2 artifact bytes to a new directory; no deployment.

project-descriptor.effects: Regenerate the canonical descriptor from edition policy and the exact setup manifest digest.

health.meaning: D1 operator-auth and development outbox schema are readable; product admission additionally requires normalized storage and active Team access.
